title: Sembcorp Green Infra IPO
summary: Sembcorp Green Infra IPO is a ₹3,750 crore book-built issue, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Sembcorp Green Infra IPO has a total issue size of 3750 crore and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

Sembcorp Green Infra financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Sembcorp Green Infra Limited was incorporated in the month of June 2005 and is an independent power producer of renewable type that focuses on developing, operating and maintenance of renewable utility scale projects in India. The Company is one of the top 10 largest renewable IPPs in India by operational capacity as on March 31, 2026, with a portfolio size of 105 renewable projects in 13 states and union territories of India. · As on March 31, 2026, the Company had operational capacity of 3.60 GW and 4.04 GW/GWh under construction capacity with 2.61 GW of renewable energy capacity and 1.43 GWh of BESS capacity. These include wind, solar, wind-solar hybrid and BESS projects and cater to central government/state government entities and private/C&I offtakers. · Sembcorp Green Infra Limited is promoted by Sembcorp Utilities Pte Ltd which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Singapore based Sembcorp Industries Ltd. · As on March 31, 2026, Sembcorp Green Infra Limited had 526 permanent employees including personnel in various areas such as business development, project development and execution, asset management, engineering, procurement, finance and accounts, and others.
Sembcorp Utilities Pte.Ltd., Sembcorp Industries Ltd. are the company's promoters of Sembcorp Green Infra.
